567: /**
568:  * Twyne sets no output ceiling of its own.
569:  *
570:  * There used to be a per-feature table of token budgets here — 380 for a
571:  * persona note, 320 for a reply, and so on — sized against how long the
572:  * visible answer ought to run. That reasoning was wrong in a way that only
573:  * shows up on models that think before they answer: the budget is spent on the
574:  * thinking too, and when it runs out mid-thought the answer never arrives. The
575:  * reply then strips to nothing and the panel files a template in its place,
576:  * which does not look like a failure. It looks like an editor with nothing
577:  * useful to say.
578:  *
579:  * A ceiling was never what kept notes short — the prompts do that. All it did
580:  * was truncate the cases it should have protected. So there is no default:
581:  * `maxOutputTokens` goes unset and each provider applies its own model
582:  * maximum, which costs nothing extra, since generation is billed on what a
583:  * model actually writes rather than on what it was permitted to.
584:  *
585:  * A writer who wants a hard cap can still set one per feature in Settings, and
586:  * that override is honoured below.
587:  */
588: function defaultMaxTokens(): number | undefined {
589:   return undefined;
590: }

593: 
594: export interface VoiceSpeechRequest {
595:   text: string;
596:   voice?: string;
597:   instructions?: string;
598:   responseFormat?: "mp3" | "opus" | "aac" | "flac" | "wav" | "pcm";
599:   speed?: number;
600:   signal?: AbortSignal;
601:   onAlignment?: (snapshot: SpeechAlignmentSnapshot) => void;
602: }
603: 
604: export interface VoiceSpeechResult {
605:   audio?: Blob;
606:   /** Native provider bytes as they arrive; preferred over waiting for `audio`. */
607:   audioStream?: ReadableStream<Uint8Array>;
608:   mimeType: string;
609:   provider: string;
610:   model: string;
611:   voice: string;
612:   responseFormat: string;
613: }
614: 
615: export async function runClientVoiceSpeech(
616:   req: VoiceSpeechRequest,
617:   settings: AiSettings,
618: ): Promise<VoiceSpeechResult | null> {
619:   const resolved = resolveFeatureConfig(settings, "voice-narration");
620:   if (!resolved) return null;
621:   if (
622:     !supportsVoiceFeature(
623:       resolved.provider.type,
624:       "voice-narration",
625:       resolved.provider,
626:     )
627:   ) {
628:     reportApplicationDiagnostic(
629:       "twyne:ai-client:voice-unsupported-provider",
630:       createAppError("CONFIGURATION_ERROR", { source: "provider" }),
631:     );
632:     return null;
633:   }
634: 
635:   const input = req.text.trim().slice(0, 4096);
636:   if (!input) return null;
637:   const generationTraceId = createAiTraceId("voice-narration");
638:   const folioId = await loadActiveFolioIdFromIdb();
639:   const usageBase = {
640:     traceId: generationTraceId,
641:     attempt: 1,
642:     source: clientUsageSourceForProvider(resolved.provider),
643:     feature: "voice-narration" as const,
644:     provider: resolved.provider.type,
645:     model: resolved.model,
646:     folioId: folioId ?? undefined,
647:     editorialActionId: `${generationTraceId}:action`,
648:   };
649: 
650:   const override = settings.perFeature["voice-narration"];
651:   const voice = req.voice ?? override?.voice ?? "alloy";
652:   const responseFormat =
653:     req.responseFormat ?? override?.responseFormat ?? "mp3";
654:   const speed = req.speed ?? override?.speed;
655:   const instructions = req.instructions ?? override?.instructions;
656: 
657:   if (resolved.provider.type === "fishaudio") {
658:     try {
659:       const result = await runFishAudioSpeech({
660:         provider: resolved.provider,
661:         model: resolved.model,
662:         text: input,
663:         voice,
664:         responseFormat,
665:         speed,
666:         signal: req.signal,
667:         onAlignment: req.onAlignment,
668:       });
669:       await settleClientUsage({
670:         ...usageBase,
671:         requestSent: true,
672:         outcome: "completed",
673:       });
674:       return result;
675:     } catch (error) {
676:       await settleClientUsage({
677:         ...usageBase,
678:         requestSent: true,
679:         outcome: "failed",
680:       });
681:       throw error;
682:     }
683:   }
684: 
685:   if (resolved.provider.type === "supertonic") {
686:     try {
687:       const { synthesizeSupertonic } = await import("./supertonic-tts");
688:       const result = await synthesizeSupertonic(input, {
689:         voice,
690:         speed: typeof speed === "number" ? speed : undefined,
691:       });
692:       await settleClientUsage({
693:         ...usageBase,
694:         requestSent: true,
695:         outcome: "completed",
696:       });
697:       return {
698:         audio: result.audio,
699:         mimeType: result.audio.type,
700:         provider: "supertonic",
701:         model: result.model,
702:         voice: result.voice ?? voice,
703:         responseFormat: result.responseFormat,
704:       };
705:     } catch (error) {
706:       await settleClientUsage({
707:         ...usageBase,
708:         requestSent: true,
709:         outcome: "failed",
710:       });
711:       throw error;
712:     }
713:   }
714: 
715:   const baseURL =
716:     isOpenAiCompatibleProvider(resolved.provider.type) &&
717:     resolved.provider.baseUrl
718:       ? resolved.provider.baseUrl.replace(/\/$/, "")
719:       : "https://api.openai.com/v1";
720: 
721:   let requestSent = false;
722:   try {
723:     requestSent = true;
724:     const res = await providerFetch(`${baseURL}/audio/speech`, {
725:       method: "POST",
726:       headers: {
727:         authorization: `Bearer ${resolved.provider.apiKey}`,
728:         "content-type": "application/json",
729:       },
730:       signal: req.signal,
731:       body: JSON.stringify({
732:         model: resolved.model,
733:         input,
734:         voice,
735:         response_format: responseFormat,
736:         ...(instructions ? { instructions } : {}),
737:         ...(speed ? { speed } : {}),
738:         stream_format: "audio",
739:       }),
740:     });
741:     if (!res.ok) {
742:       const detail = await res.text().catch(() => "");
743:       throw new Error(
744:         `Voice generation failed (${res.status}): ${detail.slice(0, 240)}`,
745:       );
746:     }
747:     const mimeType =
748:       res.headers.get("content-type")?.split(";", 1)[0] ||
749:       audioMimeType(responseFormat);
750:     const result = {
751:       ...(res.body
752:         ? { audioStream: res.body as ReadableStream<Uint8Array> }
753:         : {
754:             audio: new Blob([await res.arrayBuffer()], { type: mimeType }),
755:           }),
756:       mimeType,
757:       provider: resolved.provider.type,
758:       model: resolved.model,
759:       voice,
760:       responseFormat,
761:     };
762:     await settleClientUsage({
763:       ...usageBase,
764:       requestSent: true,
765:       providerRequestId: res.headers.get("x-request-id") ?? undefined,
766:       outcome: "completed",
767:     });
768:     return result;
769:   } catch (err) {
770:     await settleClientUsage({
771:       ...usageBase,
772:       requestSent,
773:       outcome: "failed",
774:     });
775:     reportApplicationDiagnostic("twyne:ai-client:voice", err);
776:     throw err;
777:   }
778: }
779: 
780: function audioMimeType(format: string): string {
781:   switch (format) {
782:     case "opus":
783:       return "audio/opus";
784:     case "aac":
785:       return "audio/aac";
786:     case "flac":
787:       return "audio/flac";
788:     case "wav":
789:       return "audio/wav";
790:     case "pcm":
791:       return "audio/L16";
792:     case "mp3":
793:     default:
794:       return "audio/mpeg";
795:   }
796: }

798: /**
799:  * Called as an answer arrives, with everything known *so far* — not the delta.
800:  *
801:  * Cumulative rather than a diff because every consumer is rendering a
802:  * paragraph, not appending to a terminal: it lets a `<think>` opening
803:  * mid-answer retract the text it was about to show, makes a retry a simple
804:  * reset, and makes a dropped or out-of-order call harmless.
805:  *
806:  * The snapshot carries reasoning separately from text, so a model that thinks
807:  * before answering can say so on screen instead of leaving a blank card.
808:  */
809: export type StreamText = (snapshot: GenerationStreamSnapshot) => void;
810: 
811: function recordOf(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null {
812:   return value && typeof value === "object"
813:     ? (value as Record<string, unknown>)
814:     : null;
815: }
816: 
817: async function providerRequestIdFromResult(
818:   result: unknown,
819: ): Promise<string | undefined> {
820:   try {
821:     const root = recordOf(result);
822:     const response = recordOf(await Promise.resolve(root?.response));
823:     const metadata = recordOf(root?.providerMetadata);
824:     const openai = recordOf(metadata?.openai);
825:     const candidates = [
826:       response?.id,
827:       response?.requestId,
828:       openai?.responseId,
829:       openai?.requestId,
830:     ];
831:     return candidates.find(
832:       (candidate): candidate is string =>
833:         typeof candidate === "string" && candidate.length > 0,
834:     );
835:   } catch {
836:     return undefined;
837:   }
838: }
839: 
840: /** Conservative failure classifier: plain local/configuration errors are pre-send. */
841: export function providerRequestWasSent(error: unknown): boolean {
842:   const value = recordOf(error);
843:   if (!value) return false;
844:   if (typeof value.statusCode === "number") return true;
845:   if (value.responseHeaders || value.responseBody) return true;
846:   return (
847:     typeof value.url === "string" &&
848:     ("requestBodyValues" in value || value.name === "AI_APICallError")
849:   );
850: }

852: type ClientUsageRecorder = typeof recordClientUsageAttempt;
853: let clientUsageRecorder: ClientUsageRecorder = recordClientUsageAttempt;
854: 
855: /** Test seam; production callers never replace the IndexedDB-backed recorder. */
856: export function setClientUsageRecorderForTests(
857:   recorder: ClientUsageRecorder | undefined,
858: ): void {
859:   clientUsageRecorder = recorder ?? recordClientUsageAttempt;
860: }

862: async function settleClientUsage(
863:   input: Parameters<ClientUsageRecorder>[0],
864: ): Promise<void> {
865:   try {
866:     await clientUsageRecorder(input);
867:   } catch {
868:     // Personal telemetry must never make the writing action fail.
869:   }
870: }

872: /**
873:  * One attempt at an answer, streamed when someone is listening.
874:  *
875:  * Reads `fullStream` rather than `textStream` because reasoning reaches us two
876:  * different ways and both have to land in the same place: providers with a
877:  * native reasoning channel emit `reasoning-delta` parts, while most
878:  * OpenAI-compatible endpoints inline `<think>` in the text. The accumulator
879:  * reconciles them; `textStream` would silently drop the first kind and leak
880:  * the second.
881:  */
882: async function runOnce({
883:   model,
884:   system,
885:   prompt,
886:   temperature,
887:   maxOutputTokens,
888:   providerOptions,
889:   tools,
890:   stopWhen,
891:   onText,
892: }: {
893:   model: LanguageModel;
894:   system?: string;
895:   prompt: string;
896:   temperature: number;
897:   /** Undefined leaves the ceiling to the provider's model maximum. */
898:   maxOutputTokens?: number;
899:   /** Provider-specific knobs — currently the thinking dial. Undefined sends none. */
900:   providerOptions?: ProviderOptions;
901:   tools?: ToolSet;
902:   stopWhen?: ReturnType<typeof stepCountIs>;
903:   onText?: StreamText;
904: }): Promise<{ text: string; usage?: AiUsage; providerRequestId?: string }> {
905:   if (!onText) {
906:     const result = await generateText({
907:       model,
908:       system,
909:       prompt,
910:       temperature,
911:       maxOutputTokens,
912:       ...(providerOptions ? { providerOptions } : {}),
913:       ...(tools ? { tools, stopWhen } : {}),
914:     });
915:     return {
916:       text: result.text,
917:       usage: normalizeAiUsage(result.totalUsage),
918:       providerRequestId: await providerRequestIdFromResult(result),
919:     };
920:   }
921: 
922:   const result = streamText({
923:     model,
924:     system,
925:     prompt,
926:     temperature,
927:     maxOutputTokens,
928:     ...(providerOptions ? { providerOptions } : {}),
929:     ...(tools ? { tools, stopWhen } : {}),
930:   });
931: 
932:   // Provider events arrive per token; components should not re-render per
933:   // token. The coalescer delivers the latest snapshot once per frame.
934:   const accumulator = createGenerationStreamAccumulator();
935:   const coalescer = createFrameCoalescer(onText);
936:   for await (const part of result.fullStream) {
937:     switch (part.type) {
938:       case "text-delta":
939:         coalescer.push(
940:           accumulator.push({ type: "text-delta", text: part.text }),
941:         );
942:         break;
943:       case "reasoning-start":
944:         coalescer.push(accumulator.push({ type: "reasoning-start" }));
945:         break;
946:       case "reasoning-delta":
947:         coalescer.push(
948:           accumulator.push({ type: "reasoning-delta", text: part.text }),
949:         );
950:         break;
951:       case "reasoning-end":
952:         coalescer.push(accumulator.push({ type: "reasoning-end" }));
953:         break;
954:       case "error":
955:         coalescer.push(accumulator.push({ type: "error" }));
956:         break;
957:       default:
958:         break;
959:     }
960:   }
961:   // Deliver the last frame before the caller's closing snapshot, so the two
962:   // cannot arrive out of order.
963:   coalescer.push(accumulator.push({ type: "finish" }));
964:   coalescer.flush();
965: 
966:   return {
967:     text: await result.text,
968:     usage: normalizeAiUsage(await result.totalUsage),
969:     providerRequestId: await providerRequestIdFromResult(result),
970:   };
971: }

973: async function generateTrackedText({
974:   feature,
975:   resolved,
976:   model,
977:   system,
978:   prompt,
979:   spanName,
980:   traceId,
981:   evalSignals,
982:   tools,
983:   onText,
984:   onTrace,
985:   reasoningLevel,
986: }: {
987:   feature: AiFeature;
988:   resolved: {
989:     provider: AiProviderConfig;
990:     model: string;
991:     temperature: number;
992:     maxTokens?: number;
993:   };
994:   model: LanguageModel;
995:   system?: string;
996:   prompt: string;
997:   spanName?: string;
998:   evalSignals?: Record<string, unknown>;
999:   /** Tools the model may call (e.g. quote_passage). */
1000:   tools?: ToolSet;
1001:   /** Stream the answer as it arrives. See {@link StreamText}. */
1002:   onText?: StreamText;
1003:   onTrace?: (traceId: string) => void;
1004:   /** Reuse a caller-owned trace when a streaming branch needs manual capture. */
1005:   traceId?: string;
1006:   /** Per-attempt override used by the adaptive editorial drafting loop. */
1007:   reasoningLevel?: EditorialReasoningLevel;
1008: }): Promise<string> {
1009:   system = withResponseLanguage(system, currentModelLocale());
1010:   const start = performance.now();
1011:   const generationTraceId = traceId ?? createAiTraceId(feature);
1012:   const folioId = await loadActiveFolioIdFromIdb();
1013:   const editorialActionId = `${generationTraceId}:action`;
1014:   let attempt = 0;
1015:   onTrace?.(generationTraceId);
1016:   // When tools are present the model needs at least one extra step after the
1017:   // tool result to write its visible answer.
1018:   // The quote tool needs one round trip; MCP tools can chain (search, then
1019:   // read the document it found), so give a larger budget when they are present.
1020:   const toolCount = tools ? Object.keys(tools).length : 0;
1021:   const stopWhen = tools ? stepCountIs(toolCount > 1 ? 6 : 3) : undefined;
1022:   const run = async (userPrompt: string) => {
1023:     attempt += 1;
1024:     try {
1025:       const result = await runOnce({
1026:         model,
1027:         system,
1028:         prompt: userPrompt,
1029:         temperature: resolved.temperature,
1030:         maxOutputTokens: resolved.maxTokens,
1031:         // Keyed by the model actually being used, so a feature that overrides
1032:         // the provider's default model does not inherit a dial set for a
1033:         // different model — thinking is a per-model capability.
1034:         providerOptions: reasoningLevel
1035:           ? reasoningProviderOptionsForLevel(
1036:               resolved.provider,
1037:               resolved.model,
1038:               reasoningLevel,
1039:             )
1040:           : reasoningProviderOptions(resolved.provider, resolved.model),
1041:         tools,
1042:         stopWhen,
1043:         onText,
1044:       });
1045:       await settleClientUsage({
1046:         requestSent: true,
1047:         providerRequestId: result.providerRequestId,
1048:         traceId: generationTraceId,
1049:         attempt,
1050:         source: clientUsageSourceForProvider(resolved.provider),
1051:         feature,
1052:         provider: resolved.provider.type,
1053:         model: resolved.model,
1054:         outcome: "completed",
1055:         usage: result.usage,
1056:         folioId: folioId ?? undefined,
1057:         editorialActionId,
1058:       });
1059:       return result;
1060:     } catch (error) {
1061:       await settleClientUsage({
1062:         requestSent: providerRequestWasSent(error),
1063:         traceId: generationTraceId,
1064:         attempt,
1065:         source: clientUsageSourceForProvider(resolved.provider),
1066:         feature,
1067:         provider: resolved.provider.type,
1068:         model: resolved.model,
1069:         outcome: "failed",
1070:         folioId: folioId ?? undefined,
1071:         editorialActionId,
1072:       });
1073:       throw error;
1074:     }
1075:   };
1076:   try {
1077:     const first = await run(prompt);
1078:     const text = first.text;
1079:     let usage = first.usage;
1080:     let cleaned = stripReasoningTags(text);
1081:     // Reasoning is a mode, not a defect: a model that thinks before answering
1082:     // has done nothing wrong, and the thinking is already stripped from what
1083:     // the reader sees. Only regenerate when nothing visible survived — an
1084:     // unclosed block, usually a generation truncated by the token budget —
1085:     // because that is the one case where there is no note to file.
1086:     if (!cleaned) {
1087:       const retryPrompt = `${prompt}\n\nClose your <think> block, then write the note.`;
1088:       // The empty attempt may already have painted a thinking state. Reset it
1089:       // so the reader sees a note begin rather than two answers spliced.
1090:       onText?.(textSnapshot("", "running"));
1091:       const retry = await run(retryPrompt);
1092:       usage = retry.usage ?? usage;
1093:       // Still nothing visible after a second attempt: keep the model's words
1094:       // with the tag markers removed, so the card is never blank.
1095:       cleaned =
1096:         stripReasoningTags(retry.text) || removeReasoningTagMarkers(retry.text);
1097:     }
1098:     // Streaming is best-effort progress, but the last callback is a contract:
1099:     // it must exactly match the text the caller is about to file.
1100:     onText?.(textSnapshot(cleaned));
1101:     await captureAiGeneration({
1102:       feature,
1103:       provider: resolved.provider.type,
1104:       model: resolved.model,
1105:       system,
1106:       prompt,
1107:       output: cleaned,
1108:       latencyMs: performance.now() - start,
1109:       temperature: resolved.temperature,
1110:       maxTokens: resolved.maxTokens,
1111:       spanName,
1112:       traceId: generationTraceId,
1113:       usage,
1114:       evalSignals,
1115:     });
1116:     return cleaned;
1117:   } catch (err) {
1118:     await captureAiGeneration({
1119:       feature,
1120:       provider: resolved.provider.type,
1121:       model: resolved.model,
1122:       system,
1123:       prompt,
1124:       latencyMs: performance.now() - start,
1125:       temperature: resolved.temperature,
1126:       maxTokens: resolved.maxTokens,
1127:       spanName,
1128:       traceId: generationTraceId,
1129:       error: err,
1130:       evalSignals,
1131:     });
1132:     throw err;
1133:   }
1134: }

1136: /* ── Classification (mirrors convex/agents.ts) ──────────────────── */
1137: 
1138: const typeKeywords: Record<FeedbackType, RegExp> = {
1139:   encouragement: /\b(protect|strength|alive|good|works|love|keep)\b/i,
1140:   suggestion: /\b(try|consider|suggest|add|cut|move|compress|split|drop)\b/i,
1141:   critique:
1142:     /\b(weak|fail|missing|wrong|load[- ]bearing|unstated|evade|counterpoint|reject)\b/i,
1143:   perspective:
1144:     /\b(as a|reader|audience|expect|signal|outcome|trust|confused|won over)\b/i,
1145: };
1146: 
1147: const typeOrder: FeedbackType[] = [
1148:   "critique",
1149:   "suggestion",
1150:   "encouragement",
1151:   "perspective",
1152: ];
1153: 
1154: function classifyType(text: string, fallback: FeedbackType): FeedbackType {
1155:   const scores = typeOrder.map((t) => ({
1156:     t,
1157:     score: (text.match(typeKeywords[t]) ?? []).length,
1158:   }));
1159:   scores.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
1160:   if (scores[0]?.score > 0) return scores[0].t;
1161:   return fallback;
1162: }
1163: 
1164: function defaultTypeForPersona(personaId: string): FeedbackType {
1165:   switch (personaId) {
1166:     case "devil":
1167:       return "critique";
1168:     case "angel":
1169:       return "encouragement";
1170:     case "scholar":
1171:     case "editor":
1172:       return "suggestion";
1173:     case "reader":
1174:     default:
1175:       return "perspective";
1176:   }
1177: }

1179: /* ── Rewrite response parser (mirrors convex/agents.ts) ─────────── */
1180: 
1181: function parseRewriteOutput(
1182:   text: string,
1183: ): { replacement: string; rationale: string } | null {
1184:   const stripped = stripReasoningTags(text)
1185:     .trim()
1186:     .replace(/^```(?:json)?/i, "")
1187:     .replace(/```$/, "")
1188:     .trim();
1189:   const tryParse = (s: string) => {
1190:     try {
1191:       const o = JSON.parse(s);
1192:       if (o && typeof o.replacement === "string" && o.replacement.trim()) {
1193:         return {
1194:           replacement: o.replacement.trim(),
1195:           rationale: typeof o.rationale === "string" ? o.rationale.trim() : "",
1196:         };
1197:       }
1198:     } catch {
1199:       /* fall through */
1200:     }
1201:     return null;
1202:   };
1203:   return (
1204:     tryParse(stripped) ?? tryParse(stripped.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/)?.[0] ?? "")
1205:   );
1206: }

1296: export async function runClientAgent(
1297:   feature: AiFeature,
1298:   req: AgentRequest,
1299:   settings: AiSettings,
1300:   onText?: StreamText,
1301:   adaptive?: AdaptiveClientEditorialOptions,
1302: ): Promise<AgentResponse | null> {
1303:   const resolved = resolveFeatureConfigForPersona(
1304:     settings,
1305:     feature,
1306:     req.persona,
1307:   );
1308:   if (!resolved) return null;
1309: 
1310:   const model = await createModel(resolved.provider, resolved.model);
1311:   if (!model) return null;
1312: 
1313:   try {
1314:     const system = buildSystemPrompt(req.persona);
1315:     const fallbackType = defaultTypeForPersona(req.persona.id);
1316:     // A persona can consult the writer's own knowledge bases while drafting a
1317:     // note, but only from servers explicitly marked for it in Settings.
1318:     const mcpTools = await loadMcpTools();
1319: 
1320:     if (adaptive) {
1321:       const result = await runAdaptiveEditorialDraft({
1322:         operation: req.instruction,
1323:         maxReasoning:
1324:           adaptive.maxReasoning ??
1325:           adaptiveReasoningCeiling(resolved.provider, resolved.model),
1326:         maxAttempts: adaptive.maxAttempts,
1327:         onProgress: adaptive.onProgress,
1328:         generate: async ({ attempt, reasoning, repair }) => {
1329:           const { tools: quoteTools, getAnchor } = buildQuoteTools(
1330:             req.draftText,
1331:           );
1332:           let traceId: string | undefined;
1333:           const text = await generateTrackedText({
1334:             feature,
1335:             resolved,
1336:             model,
1337:             system,
1338:             prompt: buildUserPrompt({
1339:               ...req,
1340:               ...(repair.length ? { repairInstructions: [...repair] } : {}),
1341:             }),
1342:             spanName: `${feature}:draft-${attempt}`,
1343:             evalSignals: {
1344:               twyne_persona_id: req.persona.id,
1345:               twyne_instruction: req.instruction ?? "feedback",
1346:               twyne_draft_attempt: attempt,
1347:               twyne_reasoning_level: reasoning,
1348:             },
1349:             tools: { ...quoteTools, ...mcpTools },
1350:             onTrace: (nextTraceId) => {
1351:               traceId = nextTraceId;
1352:             },
1353:             reasoningLevel: reasoning,
1354:           });
1355:           const cleaned = text.trim();
1356:           if (!cleaned) throw new Error("empty-editorial-draft");
1357:           const value: AgentResponse = {
1358:             text: cleaned,
1359:             type: classifyType(cleaned, fallbackType),
1360:             provider: resolved.provider.type as AgentResponse["provider"],
1361:             traceId,
1362:             anchor: getAnchor(),
1363:           };
1364:           return { value, text: cleaned, anchor: value.anchor };
1365:         },
1366:         review: adaptive.review,
1367:       });
1368:       if (!result.candidate) return null;
1369:       // Rejected attempts never reach the caller's stream. Only the selected
1370:       // candidate is published after the review loop is complete.
1371:       onText?.(textSnapshot(result.candidate.text));
1372:       return result.candidate.value;
1373:     }
1374: 
1375:     const user = buildUserPrompt(req);
1376:     const { tools: quoteTools, getAnchor } = buildQuoteTools(req.draftText);
1377:     const tools = { ...quoteTools, ...mcpTools };
1378:     let traceId: string | undefined;
1379: 
1380:     const text = await generateTrackedText({
1381:       feature,
1382:       resolved,
1383:       model,
1384:       system,
1385:       prompt: user,
1386:       spanName: feature,
1387:       evalSignals: {
1388:         twyne_persona_id: req.persona.id,
1389:         twyne_instruction: req.instruction ?? "feedback",
1390:       },
1391:       tools,
1392:       onText,
1393:       onTrace: (nextTraceId) => {
1394:         traceId = nextTraceId;
1395:       },
1396:     });
1397: 
1398:     const cleaned = text.trim();
1399:     const anchor = getAnchor();
1400:     // No usable text and no anchored quote — hand off to the deterministic
1401:     // local generator, which carries its own anchor.
1402:     if (!cleaned) {
1403:       return generateLocalFeedback(req);
1404:     }
1405:     return {
1406:       text: cleaned,
1407:       type: classifyType(cleaned, fallbackType),
1408:       provider: resolved.provider.type as AgentResponse["provider"],
1409:       traceId,
1410:       anchor,
1411:     };
1412:   } catch (err) {
1413:     reportApplicationDiagnostic("twyne:ai-client:generate", err);
1414:     return null;
1415:   }
1416: }

1: /**
2:  * Desktop shell bridge.
3:  *
4:  * The Electrobun desktop app loads the hosted web app in a native window at
5:  * `https://twyne.love/?platform=desktop&localAi=1&localPort=<port>`. This
6:  * module reads those URL params once so the rest of the web app can tell it is
7:  * running inside the desktop shell and discover the local MiniCPM5 LiteRT
8:  * endpoint that the desktop's Bun process exposes on loopback.
9:  *
10:  * On the plain web (no params) every getter is inert, so importing this is
11:  * safe and the local-AI surface stays hidden.
12:  */
13: 
14: interface DesktopContext {
15:   isDesktop: boolean;
16:   localAi: boolean;
17:   localPort: number | null;
18: }
19: 
20: let _ctx: DesktopContext | null = null;
21: 
22: function read(): DesktopContext {
23:   if (_ctx) return _ctx;
24:   if (typeof window === "undefined" || !window.location) {
25:     return { isDesktop: false, localAi: false, localPort: null };
26:   }
27:   const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
28:   const isDesktop = params.get("platform") === "desktop";
29:   const localAi =
30:     isDesktop &&
31:     (params.get("localAi") === "1" || params.get("localAi") === "true");
32:   const portRaw = params.get("localPort");
33:   const localPort =
34:     portRaw && /^\d+$/.test(portRaw) ? parseInt(portRaw, 10) : null;
35:   _ctx = { isDesktop, localAi, localPort };
36:   return _ctx;
37: }
38: 
39: export function isDesktopShell(): boolean {
40:   return read().isDesktop;
41: }
42: 
43: /**
44:  * True when the desktop shell explicitly advertised a local model endpoint.
45:  *
46:  * The desktop app only includes `localAi=1&localPort=<n>` after it has chosen
47:  * to launch the bundled LiteRT-LM server. Treat those params as the authoritative
48:  * capability signal so panels that normalize settings during first mount do
49:  * not miss the managed provider while PostHog flags are still loading.
50:  */
51: export function isDesktopLocalAiAvailable(): boolean {
52:   const ctx = read();
53:   return ctx.isDesktop && ctx.localAi && ctx.localPort !== null;
54: }
55: 
56: /** OpenAI-compatible base URL for the desktop's local LiteRT server, or null. */
57: export function localAiBaseUrl(): string | null {
58:   const ctx = read();
59:   if (!isDesktopLocalAiAvailable() || ctx.localPort === null) return null;
60:   return `http://127.0.0.1:${ctx.localPort}/v1`;
61: }
62: 
63: /** Default model id for the desktop local provider. */
64: export const LOCAL_MODEL_ID = "minicpm5-2b";
65: 
66: /** Stable provider id for the auto-registered local provider. */
67: export const LOCAL_PROVIDER_ID = "desktop-litert-local";
68: 
69: export function resetDesktopContextForTests(): void {
70:   _ctx = null;
71: }

1: /**
2:  * Twyne desktop — Electrobun main (Bun) process.
3:  *
4:  * Opens a single native window on the hosted Twyne web app. Everything that
5:  * makes Twyne work (Qwik SSR, Convex sync, Better Auth passkeys, ATProto
6:  * publishing) is served from the deployed site, so the desktop build ships no
7:  * application code of its own — it is a branded, self-updating shell.
8:  *
9:  * If the build was produced with local AI enabled, a native LiteRT-LM server
10:  * (OpenBMB MiniCPM5) is imported into LiteRT-LM and served on loopback, then
11:  * advertised to the page via URL params so the web app can route AI through
12:  * the local model.
13:  *
14:  * Point the window at a local dev server by setting TWYNE_DESKTOP_URL, e.g.
15:  *   TWYNE_DESKTOP_URL=http://localhost:5173 bun start
16:  */
17: import { BrowserWindow } from "electrobun/bun";
18: import { startLocalAiServer } from "./litert-server";
19: 
20: const BASE_URL = process.env.TWYNE_DESKTOP_URL ?? "https://twyne.love";
21: 
22: function withParams(base: string, params: Record<string, string>): string {
23:   const u = new URL(base);
24:   u.searchParams.set("platform", "desktop");
25:   for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) u.searchParams.set(k, v);
26:   return u.toString();
27: }
28: 
29: const local = await startLocalAiServer();
30: 
31: const url = local
32:   ? withParams(BASE_URL, { localAi: "1", localPort: String(local.port) })
33:   : withParams(BASE_URL, {});
34: 
35: const win = new BrowserWindow({
36:   title: "Twyne",
37:   url,
38:   frame: {
39:     width: 1280,
40:     height: 860,
41:     x: 80,
42:     y: 60,
43:   },
44:   titleBarStyle: "hiddenInset",
45: });
46: 
47: // Tear the local model server down with the app.
48: if (local) {
49:   const shutdown = () => local.stop();
50:   process.on("exit", shutdown);
51:   process.on("SIGINT", () => {
52:     shutdown();
53:     process.exit(0);
54:   });
55: }
56: 
57: export { win };
